prompt: Create one polished transparent PNG sprite sheet of EIGHT fantasy weather emblems for a cozy hand-painted pixel-art cave desktop. This will be overlaid on a parchment world map. Warm brass-gold light, luminous jade/teal accents, crisp painterly pixel clusters, charming tiny storybook objects, dark navy outlines and detailed shading, readable silhouettes at 80 pixels tall. EXACT layout: 4 columns by 2 rows, equal cells, large transparent gutters, each complete emblem centered inside its own cell. Top row left to right: (1) radiant golden sun, (2) golden sun peeking behind a pearly soft cloud, (3) layered blue-gray overcast clouds, (4) blue-gray raincloud releasing sparkling teal raindrops. Bottom row left to right: (5) cloud with white icy snowflakes, (6) dramatic indigo stormcloud with a brass-yellow lightning bolt and raindrops, (7) silvery fog banks with gentle curling mist, (8) a little golden compass rose with a jade question-like star, a neutral unknown-weather symbol with NO text. All individual emblems must have true transparent backgrounds, no frames, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no ground shadows outside the emblems, no room scenery. Do not crop any emblem. Cohesive colors and consistent scale, artisanal pixel-fantasy quality.
